content.title: Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release schedule: when is episode 2 on Disney Plus?
content.text: (Image credit: Marvel Studios) Daredevil: Born Again season 2 has raced out the blocks with Bullseye saving the day, Mr. Charles entering the picture, and Kingpin having several Red Hook-adjacent headaches. So, what's next?Below, you'll find the Daredevil: Born Again season 2, season 2 release date and Disney Plus streaming time, plus news of a tweaked release schedule this week.Latest Videos From GamesRadar+Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release date: what time is episode 2 streaming on Disney Plus? (Image credit: Marvel Studios)Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 2 releases on March 31, 2026, at 6:00 PM Pacific/9:00 PM Eastern on Disney PlusThat's 2 AM BST on April 1, for those across the pond in the UK. For help with other regions, you can use this handy time zone converter.Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release schedule: when are new episodes out? (Image credit: Disney Plus)A new episode of Daredevil: Born Again season 2 will hit Disney Plus every Tuesday until early May, with a total of eight episodes. While there has been recent speculation of a two-episode premiere, there is only one episode in the opening week. There are two episodes dropping on March 31 to help line things up for the Punisher one-shot special on March 12.The full Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release schedule is as follows:Bringing all the latest movie news, features, and reviews to your inboxDaredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 1: March 24, 2026 - out now!Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 2: March 31, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 3: March 31, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 4: April 7, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 5: April 14, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 6: April 21, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 7: April 28, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 8: May 5, 2026Where to watch Daredevil: Born Again season 2 (Image credit: Disney)Daredevil: Born Again season 2 is available to watch exclusively for all Disney Plus subscribers. While the first three seasons of Daredevil were produced and released by Netflix, Born Again brought Daredevil into the MCU officially, and is part of Disney's own streaming service.For more, check out our list of the best Disney Plus shows to stream right now.
